name: Aya to Koi Suru Gensoukyou
source:
Involved in the incident of Hakurei Shrine's collapse, you and Aya examine
the incident in combination, with growing affections toward each other...?

Kiss under the starlit sky, intimate sex with hand-holding and sometime from behind.
